fixes.explanation: True, friend. You read that one right. "Like the cold of snow in the time of harvest is a trustworthy messenger to those who send him; he refreshes the soul of his masters." (Proverbs 25:13) That's the picture Solomon chooses for a trustworthy messenger. The ones who send him are the ones who get refreshed.
